title: Wso2am: Apache CXF allows to set a limit on the number of form parameters in a JAX-RS message via the…
description: A high-severity security vulnerability in the wso2am package involves Apache CXF's handling of form parameters in JAX-RS messages. The vulnerability relates to the configuration option "maxFormParameterCount," which allows setting a limit on the number of form parameters. Versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 are affected. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes a denial of service by affecting availability. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
